messages:
sylvie (billing): Heads-up: BridgePay Inc (acct_9912) invoice INV-2026-811 hit 6 failed card attempts this morning. They asked for expedited wire instructions to avoid auto-suspension. Can we send instructions and consider waiving the late fee? @mira @leo

payments-bot: payment_attempt_failed: 6 attempts (2026-09-02T07:05:12Z, 07:10:23Z, 07:18:45Z, 07:25:01Z, 07:40:33Z, 08:02:10Z) -> decline_code: issuer_declined; processor_note: processing_error

peter (acct-mgr): Invoice is $12,200 due 2026-09-04. Customer claims their bank flagged the transaction for fraud and will wire instead. They asked whether Redwood covers intermediary fees and what docs are needed.

mira (treasury): Treasury checklist: require proof of transfer (MT103 or bank receipt). We cannot absorb intermediary fees by default. For one-off emergency wires for strategic customers we can credit up to $100 in intermediary fees upon receipt of MT103 showing those fees. Require originator bank to match KYC or provide AP contact verification.

leo (finance): Finance supports waiving the standard late fee ($60) if: (a) proof of wire initiation is provided within 24 hours; (b) funds post within 72 hours; AND (c) treasury confirms originator bank during KYC check. If origin bank doesn't match, AML review required before waiving.

aml-team: AML_CHECK: if originator country != customer country OR originator bank not in KYC list -> require AP email verification + bank statement (last 3 months) OR live AP call. Fast-track possible with MT103 containing originator info.

sylvie (billing): Bank block for outbound email (paste into reply):
```
Bank: Oakridge Commercial Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: 5544332211
Routing (ABA): 072000326
SWIFT: OCBKUS44
Reference: INV-2026-811 / BridgePay Inc (acct_9912)
```
Please ask the payer to include the invoice number exactly and to send MT103 or a screenshot of the transfer confirmation to billing@redwood.ai.

peter (acct-mgr): I'll send the email now with the block and the following template line: "We will hold suspension for 48 hours pending receipt of proof of wire. Once treasury confirms funds, we'll update INV-2026-811 and apply any agreed credits."

mira (treasury): One operational note: if the wire arrives in USD via intermediary, treasury will post the net amount after fees and record the fee line. If they want Redwood to reimburse intermediary fees, they must include the MT103 showing the fee and we'll issue a credit within the following invoice cycle.

leo (finance): Also add an AR ticket to reconcile FX/fee differences if any. Post-payment tasks: set payment method to 'wire', run usage reconciliation, and trigger payment-received webhook.

sylvie (billing): Moving INV-2026-811 to "awaiting wire" and emailing customer. Will tag treasury and AML when MT103 arrives. :white_check_mark:
